inputs.text: [excited] KEN… troh… SOR… us. [curious] In Greek, "kentron" means a spike, a sharp point.
[happily] Yep — it had them all over its back. [calm] It lived in Africa, in Tanzania, a hundred fifty-five million years ago.
[amazed] Its African cousin, Giraffatitan, [proud] lived in that exact same spot, at the exact same time.
